scope: Isolated local PostgreSQL; synthetic fixed accounts only; no production connection

SHARE_REVOKE_AND_LEAVE.evidence: default private; grant permits edit; actual blocked edit/revoke race serialized; leave removes record

FINISH_VS_LEAVE.evidence: both lock orders observed: finish then leave, leave then finish; no deadlock or post-leave plan
